name: thumbnail_text_engine
description: Generates short thumbnail text from a video concept, enforces character and contrast constraints, and scores hook strength.

functions.name: generate_thumbnail_text
functions.description: Generates thumbnail text from a video concept.

args.name: video_concept
args.description: The concept or title of the video.

args.name: max_chars
args.description: Maximum number of characters allowed in the thumbnail text.

args.name: min_contrast
args.description: Minimum contrast score required for the text.

functions.name: calculate_contrast_score
functions.description: Calculates the contrast score of the given text.

args.name: text
args.description: The text to calculate the contrast score for.

returns.description: The contrast score of the text.

functions.name: score_hook_strength
functions.description: Scores the hook strength of the given thumbnail text.

returns.description: The hook strength score of the thumbnail text.
